tasks.title: ssrf.check_host with injectable resolver
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_mcp_ssrf.py passes with a fake resolver: one deny case each for loopback, link-local (169.254.169.254), 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7, unspecified and multicast, plus a single-label name (M1, T6); 2001:db8::1 is not single-label; ::ffff:10.0.0.1 is denied as IPv4 (E5); a host with one public and one private IP is denied (E1); an allowlisted host N8N matches n8n and skips the check (E2); a resolver error is a deny (E7); ruff and mypy report 0 errors

tasks.title: Config validators (tools map, headers, device, stdio env) and migrate #28 tests to tools map
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_mcp_config.py passes: entries are rejected with a logged error for a name 'device', a literal header value, a shared MCP_SECRET_* name across two entries, a stdio env key API_KEY, a stdio env value starting MCP_SECRET_, headers on a stdio entry (E6), the old tools list form and a pin not matching sha256:<64 hex> (M5, 5 of 5); a valid https entry with headers and a tools map loads; all existing #28 tests (test_mcp_config, test_mcp_source, test_mcp_adapters, test_mcp_registry, test_mcp_e2e) use the tools map form and pass with `cd server && pytest`; ruff and mypy report 0 errors

tasks.title: HashToolFilter (hash, caps) and per-tool try in McpSource
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_mcp_toolfilter.py tests/test_mcp_source.py passes: a matching pin is admitted, a missing pin and a changed description are not admitted and the WARNING log holds the tool name and current sha256 hash, a 1 001 char description is not admitted with an ERROR log (M2, 4 of 4, T4); a canonical schema over 4 000 chars is not admitted; the hash is stable over a fixed fixture; a filter that raises hides only that tool, the other tools stay and McpHub.run does not raise (F4); an unadmitted tool call is an unknown tool (F3); ruff and mypy report 0 errors

tasks.title: NoRedirectTransport and guarded client in adapters
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_mcp_adapters.py passes: for http and sse a fake server on 127.0.0.1 that answers a same-origin 307 makes the connect fail in under 2 s (M3, T8); a 307 on a mid-session call returns an error outcome and the call returns an error outcome without a crash; RedirectBlocked is not an httpx.TransportError; the passed timeout and headers reach the client; existing adapter and reconnect tests still pass; ruff and mypy report 0 errors
